## Technical analysis (Tuesday June 30 — KST session complete)

**June 30 KST session (intraday data, confirmed close pending):** Open ₩2,608,000 / High ₩2,742,000 / Low ₩2,541,000. Close unconfirmed.

**Critical event: Stop ₩2,540,000 tested at ₩2,541,000 (₩1,000 margin).** This is the most critical capital preservation event since the circuit breaker sessions. The stop was NOT triggered on an intraday basis (stop is measured on CLOSING basis only). However, a ₩1,000 intraday margin from mandatory full exit on a session that opened below both the June 29 close AND the re-entry threshold constitutes a STOP PROXIMITY CRISIS.

**ADR underwriter mandate demonstrably active.** V-recovery from ₩2,541,000 to ₩2,742,000 (₩201,000 range, +7.9% intraday) within a single session is consistent with institutional stabilization buying. Four underwriter banks have contractual obligation to defend the pricing range through July 10.

**Re-entry gates (June 30):** Gate 1 (KOSPI > 8,500): KOSPI June 29 confirmed 8,395 — Gate 1 FAILED on June 29. June 30 KOSPI close unconfirmed. Gate 2 (SK Hynix > ₩2,700,000): June 30 close unconfirmed; intraday high ₩2,742,000 exceeded threshold but close is the gate.

**US tailwind:** Nasdaq +2.07% (June 29), VIX 16.41, SCOTUS ruling — should support KOSPI June 30 positive bias. Insufficient to prevent intraday flush to ₩2,541,000.

so_what.line: The stop at ₩2,540,000 was tested to within ₩1,000 intraday on June 30 before a V-shaped recovery drove the stock above the ₩2,700,000 re-entry threshold — ADR underwriters demonstrably absorbed the flush, but the ₩1,000 stop margin is a capital preservation alert that demands confirmed close data before any position action.
so_what.bull: Four of the world's largest banks drove a ₩201,000 intraday recovery from the stop test to above the re-entry threshold in a single session — the institutional floor is empirically validated, and with 10 days to ADR listing and Samsung $226B AI data centers confirmed, the structural thesis has never been stronger.
so_what.bear: The US session's best macro day of the correction cycle (Nasdaq +2.07%, SCOTUS, VIX 16.41) provided tailwind and SK Hynix STILL tested the mandatory stop threshold intraday — if the underwriter bid were not present, the stop would have been triggered; the Korean-specific selling pressure is real and the ₩1,000 intraday margin from a mandatory full exit is not a comfortable buffer.
